attributes.action: Review and overhaul the current U.K benefits system
attributes.additional_details:
My petition is to highlight that an employed U.K citizen pays tax, national insurance, childcare, dental care, eye care, rent, council tax household bills etc....

Where-as,

A U.K citizen unemployed and claiming benefits pay No tax, national insurance, No rent or council tax and recieve government grants toward privately leased property. Recieve free dental & eye care but to name a few......

In the U.K its easier & finanally more beneficial to be unemployed than to work.

Unacceptable.
attributes.background:
This petition is about the current U.K benefits system which is unfair and shambolic. 
Currently, its far more attractive to be unemployed and claim benefits than it is to remain employed and provide for your families.

rejection.details: It's not entirely clear in what way you want the system to be reformed. Your petition is more a statement of dissatisfaction than a request for a particular, clear action.
